description.fun: Fennekin is a little fennec fox with a fiery temper: it vents air hotter than 200 °C from its huge ears to scare off rivals. It loves to chew on twigs, which fill it with energy, and in Pokémon Legends: Z-A a special Revitalizing Twig can perk up even a sickly Fennekin better than a Pokémon Center can. Like the kitsune of Japanese folklore, it's a fox with magic in its future.
description.guide: Fennekin is a Fire-type fox Pokémon and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Kalos in Pokémon X and Y. Modelled on the fennec fox, it blows hot air from its large ears to intimidate opponents and gets its energy from chewing twigs. It evolves into Braixen and then Delphox.
description.tagline: A twig-chewing fennec fox that vents fire from its ears

description.fun: Braixen is a young witch in fox form: it keeps a stick tucked in its bushy tail like a broomstick, and pulling it out lights it from the friction, like striking a match. It uses the flaming twig to fight, to calm itself down, and to talk, drawing circles of fire in the air to warn others of danger. Its name mixes 'vixen' with the French 'braise', hot charcoal.
description.guide: Braixen is a Fire-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Fennekin's line. It carries a twig in its tail that ignites when drawn, and uses the flame both in battle and to signal danger to others. Its look draws on fennec foxes, Japanese fox folklore and witches.
description.tagline: A fox witch who keeps a magic wand in its tail

description.fun: Delphox is a fortune-teller fox: it stares into the flame at the tip of its wand until its mind is still enough to see the future, and people in ancient times read omens in the burn marks it left on the ground. Its psychic power can trap foes in a fiery vortex of 3,000 °C. It's the only Psychic-type first partner Pokémon, and its name nods to the Delphic oracle.
description.guide: Delphox is a Fire- and Psychic-type Pokémon, the final form of Fennekin and the only Psychic-type first partner Pokémon. It wields a burning branch like a wand, hides it in its sleeve-like fur, and is said to see the future in its flame. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Delphox, introduced in Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: A robed fox mage that reads the future in its flame

description.fun: Mega Delphox, from Pokémon Legends: Z-A, becomes a witch riding a flaming broomstick, with a long white wizard's beard and black-tipped robes. Two smaller burning branches float beside it as if alive, and it can merge their flames with its own fire breath into one huge fireball.
